# Echo double[][]: the result must be the input, exactly.

@example
[[0.1,1e+300,5e-324,-1e-300],[2.5],[]]
=> [[0.1,1e+300,5e-324,-1e-300],[2.5],[]]

[[0.30000000000000004,1.7976931348623157e+308,-123456789.125,2.0]]
=> [[0.30000000000000004,1.7976931348623157e+308,-123456789.125,2.0]]

[[-0.0,0.0]]
=> [[-0.0,0.0]]
